system.description: An elder rallies assembled anarch packs into directed frenzy with a rousing, hateful speech. Win a mass Social Test (retest with Leadership) and as many Kindred as the elder has Social Traits enter frenzy targeting whoever the elder names, regardless of their Path of Enlightenment - the frenzied vampires won't turn on each other over this target. They must keep chanting the elder's given slogan or war cry or the effect ends immediately for them. Extremely dangerous to use: it's an open Masquerade breach and the war cry itself often identifies the elder responsible.
system.duration: Until the chant stops or the scene ends
